hypotheses.R0_native_patches_are_exact: Native patches reproduce all finite effects and final answer coordinates at fidelity at least 0.9999.
hypotheses.R1_arbitrary_load_globally_broadens_midd: For every paired run, pure rank-32 fidelity exceeds mixed-unselected rank-32 by at least 0.05 in Layer 1 or 2.
hypotheses.R2_pure_semantics_emerge_earlier: For every paired run, pure answer-span fidelity exceeds mixed-unselected by at least 0.15 in Layer 1 or 2.
hypotheses.R3_both_regimes_share_a_final_answer_quo: Final-layer answer-span fidelity reaches at least 0.90 in every pure and mixed status/run.
hypotheses.R4_pure_middle_program_has_lower_tested_: The sum of Layer-1 and Layer-2 tested K90 ranks is smaller for pure than mixed-unselected in every paired run.
hypotheses.R5_mixed_selected_and_unselected_share_l: At Layers 2-3, selected versus unselected rank-64 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 in every mixed run.
hypotheses.R6_template_transfer_is_stable: Rank-64 fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every regime, layer, and status.
hypotheses.R7_signal_gate_passes: Every finite-effect cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
